## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 1 sept 2026 - 5 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _silna salim_, 5 sept 2026, 1/5: "The automatic renewal of my subscription has occurred, and I am currently unable to cancel it. This service does not align with my fitness preferences and has proven to be entirely unhelpful. A monthly payment has been automatically debited from my account. I cancelled your service within five minutes of the renewal. I require a full refund for this charge."
            2. _khaldonalsalami_, 1 sept 2026, 1/5: "useless just want to cancel subscription"
            3. _Akash Mishra_, 3 sept 2026, 4/5: "However, the customer service and help desk experience has fallen short of the high standards set by the app itself. When encountering technical questions, subscription management concerns, or account-specific dashboard issues, getting a clear, timely, and effective resolution can be frustrating. Often, responses feel slow or lack the specific context needed to resolve account-related hurdles smoothly."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      6 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 23 may 2026 - 3 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Jay Gardam_, 31 ago 2026, 1/5: "app keeps crashing. only started yesterday. paid and now can't get in."
            2. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23 may 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            3. _Kendall Buggs_, 2 sept 2026, 2/5: "Ridiculously glitchy app. Pointless"
<!--/ir-theme-->
